en: If the stars should appear one night in a thousand years, how would men believe and adore.
zh: 假如星星一千年才出现一夜，人们将会多么虔信、多么崇拜。
line: If the stars should appear one night in a thousand years, how would men believe and adore. — Ralph Waldo Emerson

word.zh: n. 印度地方，西印度群岛
word.ex: The pirates hid their treasure on a small island in the West Indies.
word.exzh: 海盗们把财宝藏在西印度群岛的一座小岛上。
